title: PAL: Designing Conversational Agents as Scalable, Cooperative Patient Simulators for Palliative-Care Training
reasoning: The paper focuses on the design and usability evaluation of an LLM-based system (PAL) for training medical students and clinicians in communication skills for palliative care. While palliative care involves sensitive end-of-life topics, the study focuses on communication strategies (empathy frameworks like NURSE) rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical reasoning.
